metadata.description: The Microsoft Sentinel workspace into which the function will be deployed. Has to be in the selected Resource Group.
The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: Audit Event ASIM filtering parser for AWS CloudTrail EC2 AccountAndInfrastructure activity
properties.query:
let parser = (
  starttime:datetime=datetime(null),
  endtime:datetime=datetime(null),
  srcipaddr_has_any_prefix:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  actorusername_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  operation_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  eventtype_in:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  eventresult:string='*',
  object_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  newvalue_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  disabled:bool=false,
  pack:bool=false
) {
let Events = datatable(EventName: string, EventType: string, Object: string)
[
  "CancelDeclarativePoliciesReport", "Delete", "Account Status Report",
  "CreateCarrierGateway", "Create", "Carrier Gateway",
  "CreateCoipCidr", "Create", "COIP Pool",
  "CreateCoipPool", "Create", "COIP Pool",
  "CreateLocalGatewayRoute", "Create", "Local Gateway Route Table",
  "CreateLocalGatewayRouteTable", "Create", "Local Gateway Route Table",
  "CreateLocalGatewayRouteTableVirtualInterfaceGroupAssociation", "Create", "Local Gateway Route Table Virtual Interface Group Association",
  "CreateLocalGatewayRouteTableVpcAssociation", "Create", "Local Gateway Route Table VPC Association",
  "CreateLocalGatewayVirtualInterface", "Create", "Local Gateway Virtual Interface",
  "CreateLocalGatewayVirtualInterfaceGroup", "Create", "Local Gateway Virtual Interface Group",
  "CreateManagedPrefixList", "Create", "Prefix List",
  "CreateSecondaryNetwork", "Create", "Secondary Network",
  "CreateSecondarySubnet", "Create", "Secondary Subnet",
  "CreateTags", "Create", "EC2 Resources",
  "DeleteCarrierGateway", "Delete", "Carrier Gateway",
  "DeleteCoipCidr", "Set", "COIP Pool",
  "DeleteCoipPool", "Delete", "COIP Pool",
  "DeleteLocalGatewayRoute", "Set", "Local Gateway Route Table",
  "DeleteLocalGatewayRouteTable", "Delete", "Local Gateway Route Table",
  "DeleteLocalGatewayRouteTableVirtualInterfaceGroupAssociation", "Delete", "Local Gateway Route Table Virtual Interface Group Association",
  "DeleteLocalGatewayRouteTableVpcAssociation", "Delete", "Local Gateway Route Table VPC Association",
  "DeleteLocalGatewayVirtualInterface", "Delete", "Local Gateway Virtual Interface",
  "DeleteLocalGatewayVirtualInterfaceGroup", "Delete", "Local Gateway Virtual Interface",
  "DeleteManagedPrefixList", "Delete", "Managed Prefix List",
  "DeleteSecondaryNetwork", "Delete", "Secondary Network",
  "DeleteSecondarySubnet", "Delete", "Secondary Subnet",
  "DeleteTags", "Delete", "EC2 Resources",
  "DeregisterInstanceEventNotificationAttributes", "Delete", "Tag Key",
  "DescribeAccountAttributes", "Read", "Account Attributes",
  "DescribeAggregateIdFormat", "Read", "EC2 Resources",
  "DescribeAvailabilityZones", "Read", "Availability Zones",
  "DescribeAwsNetworkPerformanceMetricSubscriptions", "Read", "Infrastructure Performance Metric Subscriptions",
  "DescribeCarrierGateways", "Read", "Carrier Gateway",
  "DescribeCoipPools", "Read", "COIP Pool",
  "DescribeDeclarativePoliciesReports", "Read", "Account Status Report",
  "DescribeElasticGpus", "Read", "Elastic Gpu",
  "DescribeIdFormat", "Read", "EC2 Resources",
  "DescribeIdentityIdFormat", "Read", "EC2 Resources",
  "DescribeInstanceTopology", "Read", "EC2 Instance",
  "DescribeInstanceTypeOfferings", "Read", "EC2 Instance",
  "DescribeInstanceTypes", "Read", "EC2 Instance",
  "DescribeLocalGatewayRouteTableVirtualInterfaceGroupAssociations", "Read", "Local Gateway Route Table Virtual Interface Group Association",
  "DescribeLocalGatewayRouteTableVpcAssociations", "Read", "Local Gateway Route Table VPC Association",
  "DescribeLocalGatewayRouteTables", "Read", "Local Gateway Route Table",
  "DescribeLocalGatewayVirtualInterfaceGroups", "Read", "Local Gateway Virtual Interface Group",
  "DescribeLocalGatewayVirtualInterfaces", "Read", "Local Gateway Virtual Interface Group",
  "DescribeLocalGateways", "Read", "Local Gateway",
  "DescribeManagedPrefixLists", "Read", "Prefix List",
  "DescribeOutpostLags", "Read", "LAGs",
  "DescribePrefixLists", "Read", "Prefix List",
  "DescribePrincipalIdFormat", "Read", "EC2 Resources",
  "DescribeRegions", "Read", "EC2 Resources",
  "DescribeSecondaryInterfaces", "Read", "Secondary Interface",
  "DescribeSecondaryNetworks", "Read", "Secondary Network",
  "DescribeSecondarySubnets", "Read", "Secondary Subnet",
  "DescribeServiceLinkVirtualInterfaces", "Read", "Service Link Virtual Interface",
  "DescribeTags", "Read", "EC2 Tags",
  "DisableAwsNetworkPerformanceMetricSubscription", "Disable", "Metric Subscription",
  "EnableAwsNetworkPerformanceMetricSubscription", "Enable", "Metric Subscription",
  "GetAwsNetworkPerformanceData", "Read", "Network Performance Data",
  "GetCoipPoolUsage", "Read", "COIP Pool",
  "GetDeclarativePoliciesReportSummary", "Read", "Account Status Report",
  "GetInstanceTypesFromInstanceRequirements", "Read", "EC2 Instance",
  "GetManagedPrefixListAssociations", "Read", "Managed Prefix List",
  "GetManagedPrefixListEntries", "Read", "Managed Prefix List",
  "GetManagedResourceVisibility", "Read", "Managed Resource Visibility",
  "ModifyAvailabilityZoneGroup", "Set", "Availability Zone Group",
  "ModifyIdFormat", "Set", "EC2 Resources",
  "ModifyIdentityIdFormat", "Set", "EC2 Resources",
  "ModifyLocalGatewayRoute", "Set", "Local Gateway Route Table",
  "ModifyManagedPrefixList", "Set", "Managed Prefix List",
  "ModifyManagedResourceVisibility", "Set", "Managed Resource Visibility",
  "RestoreManagedPrefixListVersion", "Set", "Managed Prefix List",
  "SearchLocalGatewayRoutes", "Read", "Local Gateway Route Table",
  "StartDeclarativePoliciesReport", "Start", "Policies Report"
]
| where array_length(eventtype_in) == 0 or EventType in (eventtype_in)
| where array_length(object_has_any) == 0 or Object has_any (object_has_any);
AWSCloudTrail
| where not(disabled)
| where EventSource == "ec2.amazonaws.com"
| where (isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime)
    and (isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated <= endtime)
| where array_length(operation_has_any) == 0 or EventName has_any (operation_has_any)
| where array_length(actorusername_has_any) == 0 or UserIdentityUserName has_any (actorusername_has_any)
| where array_length(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0
    or (ipv4_is_in_range(SourceIpAddress, "0.0.0.0/0")
        and has_any_ipv4_prefix(SourceIpAddress, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix))
| where EventName in (Events | project EventName)
| extend EventResult = iff(isempty(ErrorCode) and isempty(ErrorMessage), "Success", "Failure")
| where eventresult == "*" or EventResult == eventresult
| lookup kind=inner Events on EventName
| extend Req = todynamic(RequestParameters), Resp = todynamic(ResponseElements)
| extend NewValue = iff(EventResult == "Success", case(
    EventName == "CreateCarrierGateway", Resp.carrierGateway,
    EventName in ("CreateCoipCidr", "DeleteCoipCidr"), Resp.coipCidr,
    EventName == "CreateCoipPool", Resp.coipPool,
    EventName in ("CreateLocalGatewayRoute", "DeleteLocalGatewayRoute"), Resp.route,
    EventName == "CreateLocalGatewayRouteTable", Resp.localGatewayRouteTable,
    EventName == "CreateLocalGatewayRouteTableVirtualInterfaceGroupAssociation",
      Resp.localGatewayRouteTableVirtualInterfaceGroupAssociation,
    EventName == "CreateLocalGatewayRouteTableVpcAssociation",
      Resp.localGatewayRouteTableVpcAssociation,
    EventName == "CreateLocalGatewayVirtualInterface", Resp.localGatewayVirtualInterface,
    EventName == "CreateLocalGatewayVirtualInterfaceGroup",
      Resp.localGatewayVirtualInterfaceGroup,
    EventName in ("CreateManagedPrefixList", "RestoreManagedPrefixListVersion"), Resp.prefixList,
    EventName == "CreateSecondaryNetwork", Resp.secondaryNetwork,
    EventName == "CreateSecondarySubnet", Resp.secondarySubnet,
    EventName == "CreateTags", Req.tagSet.items,
    EventName == "EnableAwsNetworkPerformanceMetricSubscription", Req.Source,
    EventName == "ModifyManagedResourceVisibility", Resp.visibility,
    ""
  ), "")
| where array_length(newvalue_has_any) == 0 or NewValue has_any (newvalue_has_any)
| extend ObjectId = case(
    EventName in ("CancelDeclarativePoliciesReport", "DescribeDeclarativePoliciesReports"),
      Req.ReportId,
    EventName == "CreateCarrierGateway", Resp.carrierGateway.carrierGatewayId,
    EventName in ("CreateCoipCidr", "DeleteCoipCidr", "DeleteCoipPool"), Req.CoipPoolId,
    EventName == "CreateCoipPool", Resp.coipPool.poolId,
    EventName == "CreateLocalGatewayRoute", Resp.route.localGatewayRouteTableId,
    EventName == "CreateLocalGatewayRouteTable",
      Resp.localGatewayRouteTable.localGatewayRouteTableId,
    EventName == "CreateLocalGatewayRouteTableVirtualInterfaceGroupAssociation",
      Resp.localGatewayRouteTableVirtualInterfaceGroupAssociation.localGatewayRouteTableVirtualInterfaceGroupAssociationId,
    EventName == "CreateLocalGatewayRouteTableVpcAssociation",
      Resp.localGatewayRouteTableVpcAssociation.localGatewayRouteTableVpcAssociationId,
    EventName == "CreateLocalGatewayVirtualInterface",
      Resp.localGatewayVirtualInterface.localGatewayVirtualInterfaceId,
    EventName == "CreateLocalGatewayVirtualInterfaceGroup",
      Resp.localGatewayVirtualInterfaceGroup.localGatewayVirtualInterfaceGroupId,
    EventName == "CreateManagedPrefixList", Resp.prefixList.prefixListId,
    EventName == "CreateSecondaryNetwork", Resp.secondaryNetwork.secondaryNetworkId,
    EventName == "CreateSecondarySubnet", Resp.secondarySubnet.secondarySubnetId,
    EventName == "CreateTags", Req.resourcesSet.items,
    EventName in ("DeleteCarrierGateway", "DescribeCarrierGateways"), Req.CarrierGatewayId,
    EventName in ("DeleteLocalGatewayRoute", "DeleteLocalGatewayRouteTable",
      "DescribeLocalGatewayRouteTables", "ModifyLocalGatewayRoute", "SearchLocalGatewayRoutes"),
      Req.LocalGatewayRouteTableId,
    EventName in ("DeleteLocalGatewayRouteTableVirtualInterfaceGroupAssociation",
      "DescribeLocalGatewayRouteTableVirtualInterfaceGroupAssociations"),
      Req.LocalGatewayRouteTableVirtualInterfaceGroupAssociationId,
    EventName in ("DeleteLocalGatewayRouteTableVpcAssociation",
      "DescribeLocalGatewayRouteTableVpcAssociations"),
      Req.LocalGatewayRouteTableVpcAssociationId,
    EventName in ("DeleteLocalGatewayVirtualInterface", "DescribeLocalGatewayVirtualInterfaces"),
      Req.LocalGatewayVirtualInterfaceId,
    EventName in ("DeleteLocalGatewayVirtualInterfaceGroup", "DescribeLocalGatewayVirtualInterfaceGroups"),
      Req.LocalGatewayVirtualInterfaceGroupId,
    EventName in ("DeleteManagedPrefixList", "DescribeManagedPrefixLists", "DescribePrefixLists",
      "GetManagedPrefixListAssociations", "GetManagedPrefixListEntries", "ModifyManagedPrefixList",
      "RestoreManagedPrefixListVersion"), Req.PrefixListId,
    EventName in ("DeleteSecondaryNetwork", "DescribeSecondaryNetworks"),
      Req.SecondaryNetworkId,
    EventName == "DeleteSecondarySubnet", Req.SecondarySubnetId,
    EventName == "DeleteTags", Req.ResourceId,
    EventName == "DeregisterInstanceEventNotificationAttributes",
      Resp.instanceTagAttribute.instanceTagKeySet,
    EventName == "DescribeAccountAttributes", Req.AttributeName,
    EventName == "DescribeAggregateIdFormat", Resp.statusSet,
    EventName == "DescribeAvailabilityZones", Resp.availabilityZoneInfo,
    EventName == "DescribeAwsNetworkPerformanceMetricSubscriptions", Resp.subscriptionSet,
    EventName in ("DescribeCoipPools", "GetCoipPoolUsage"), Req.PoolId,
    EventName == "DescribeElasticGpus", Req.ElasticGpuId,
    EventName == "DescribeInstanceTopology", Req.InstanceId.N,
    EventName == "DescribeLocalGateways", Req.LocalGatewayId,
    EventName == "DescribeOutpostLags", Req.OutpostLagId,
    EventName == "DescribeSecondaryInterfaces", Req.SecondaryInterfaceId,
    EventName == "DescribeServiceLinkVirtualInterfaces", Req.ServiceLinkVirtualInterfaceId,
    EventName in ("GetDeclarativePoliciesReportSummary", "StartDeclarativePoliciesReport"),
      Resp.reportId,
    EventName == "ModifyAvailabilityZoneGroup", Req.GroupName,
    ""
  )
| extend
    Type = "AWSCloudTrail",
    EventCount = int(1),
    EventStartTime = TimeGenerated,
    EventEndTime = TimeGenerated,
    EventSeverity = "Informational",
    EventSchema = "AuditEvent",
    EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
    EventVendor = "AWS",
    EventProduct = "CloudTrail",
    Dvc = "CloudTrail",
    EventMessage = ErrorMessage,
    ObjectType = "Cloud Resource",
    TargetAppName = "Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud",
    TargetAppType = "Service"
| project-rename
    EventOriginalSubType = EventTypeName,
    EventOriginalType = EventName,
    EventUid = AwsEventId,
    EventOriginalResultDetails = ErrorMessage,
    EventProductVersion = EventVersion,
    ActorUserId = UserIdentityAccountId,
    ActorUsername = UserIdentityUserName,
    ActorOriginalUserType = UserIdentityType,
    HttpUserAgent = UserAgent
| extend
    ActorUserIdType = iff(isempty(ActorUserId), "", "AWSId"),
    ActorUsernameType = iff(isempty(ActorUsername), "", "Simple"),
    SrcIpAddr = iff(ipv4_is_in_range(SourceIpAddress, "0.0.0.0/0"), SourceIpAddress, ""),
    ActingApplicationEntityKey = "",
    ActorUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
    ActorUserEntityKey = "",
    AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]),
    DvcEntityKey = "",
    SrcSystemEntityKey = "",
    TargetApplicationEntityKey = "",
    TargetSystemEntityKey = ""
| extend AdditionalFields = iff(pack, bag_pack(
    "ActorAccessKeyId", UserIdentityAccessKeyId,
    "AWSRegion", AWSRegion,
    "APIVersion", APIVersion,
    "ManagementEvent", ManagementEvent,
    "ReadOnly", ReadOnly,
    "RequestParameters", Req,
    "ResponseElements", Resp
  ), dynamic({}))
| extend
    Operation = EventOriginalType,
    User = ActorUsername,
    IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
    Application = TargetAppName,
    Value = NewValue
| project
    TimeGenerated, Type, EventCount, EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventSeverity,
    EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion, EventVendor, EventProduct, Dvc, EventResult,
    EventMessage, TargetAppName, EventOriginalSubType, EventOriginalType, EventUid,
    EventOriginalResultDetails, EventProductVersion, ActorUserId, ActorUsername,
    ActorOriginalUserType, HttpUserAgent, ActorUserIdType, ActorUsernameType,
    SrcIpAddr, AdditionalFields, User, IpAddr, Application, EventType, NewValue,
    Value, ObjectId, ObjectType, Object, TargetAppType, Operation,
    ActingApplicationEntityKey, ActorUserAdditionalIds, ActorUserEntityKey,
    AdditionalEntities, DvcEntityKey, SrcSystemEntityKey,
    TargetApplicationEntityKey, TargetSystemEntityKey
};
parser(
  starttime,
  endtime,
  srcipaddr_has_any_prefix,
  actorusername_has_any,
  operation_has_any,
  eventtype_in,
  eventresult,
  object_has_any,
  newvalue_has_any,
  disabled,
  pack
)
